exam_price_notes: Check the official booking page for the price in your country or region.
renewal_options: Microsoft Fundamentals certifications do not expire and do not require renewal.
target_audience: Technology professionals who want to demonstrate foundational knowledge of cloud concepts in general and Microsoft Azure in particular
recommended_experience: Skills and experience working with an area of IT, such as: Infrastructure management, Database management, Software development

prerequisites.description: Skills and experience working with an area of IT, such as: Infrastructure management, Database management, Software development

retake_policy.notes: After the first failure, wait 24 hours. Wait 14 days between later attempts. At most five attempts in the 12 months starting with the first attempt; after five failures, wait until that period ends. Retake fees apply. See Microsoft's policy for exceptions.

study_actions.title: Atlas study exercise: Compare responsibility across service models
study_actions.detail: Pick a small web application and describe it using infrastructure, platform and software service models. For each, identify which responsibilities remain with the customer. Then connect your choice to the cloud concepts, Azure services and governance objectives. This is a study aid, not an official exam question or a prediction of your result.
